nodes.name: TTS Backend Base Utilities
nodes.description: Shared utilities for TTS/STT backend implementations, including model caching, device detection, and audio processing.
nodes.summary: Provides functions for cache checking, device detection (CUDA/ROCm/MPS/XPU), voice prompt combination, and model loading progress tracking across all TTS engines.

nodes.name: Backend Python Project Manifest
nodes.description: Python project configuration for Voicebox backend, including Ruff linter and pytest settings.
nodes.summary: Configures Ruff for linting/formatting and pytest for testing. Requires Python 3.12+.

nodes.name: add-tts-engine Skill Guide
nodes.description: Comprehensive, multi-phase guide for integrating a new TTS engine into Voicebox.
nodes.summary: Step-by-step process covering dependency research, backend/frontend implementation, and PyInstaller bundling.

nodes.name: Triage PRs Skill Guide
nodes.description: Skill to triage open PRs before a release: classifies them into must-merge, candidate, superseded, or deferred, and executes a tracked merge loop.
nodes.summary: Workflow involves setting up a review worktree, gathering metadata, classifying into tiers, and executing the merge loop with a tracked triage doc.

nodes.name: Draft Release Notes Skill Guide
nodes.description: Skill to generate a narrative release story for the [Unreleased] section of CHANGELOG.md based on recent commit history.
nodes.summary: Follows a structured format focusing on theme groups and narrative over simple lists.

nodes.name: App Package Manifest
nodes.description: Node.js package manifest for the Voicebox React frontend application.
nodes.summary: Lists key dependencies: React, Zustand, React Query, TanStack Router, Radix UI, Tailwind, and Tauri API plugins. Build system: Vite.

nodes.name: TTS Generation Endpoints
nodes.description: FastAPI endpoints for TTS speech generation, retry, regeneration, status streaming, and direct audio streaming.
nodes.summary: Handles POST /generate, retry, regenerate, SSE status streaming, and direct WAV audio streaming via /generate/stream.

nodes.name: Voicebox Main App Component
nodes.description: Root React component for the Voicebox app, handling server lifecycle, auto-update, and initial UI routing.
nodes.summary: Manages server auto-start, health-check polling, loading screen with cycling messages, and lifecycle callbacks for platform integration.

nodes.name: Tauri Desktop App Main Entry Point
nodes.description: Rust main entry point for the Tauri desktop application, managing server lifecycle, audio capture, and window events.
nodes.summary: Handles server auto-start/stop, platform-specific process detection, audio capture/output, and window close events with keep-running functionality.

nodes.name: Voicebox Contributing Guide
nodes.description: Comprehensive guide for contributing to Voicebox, covering development setup, code style, and the PR process.
nodes.summary: Details prerequisites, setup via `just setup`, development workflow, and API development guidelines for FastAPI and React.

nodes.name: FastAPI Application Factory
nodes.description: Core FastAPI application factory and lifecycle management for Voicebox, including CORS, GPU detection, and startup/shutdown events.
nodes.summary: Handles CORS configuration, GPU detection (CUDA/ROCm/MPS/MLX/XPU), model loading/unloading, and serves the built React frontend in production.

nodes.name: Voicebox Changelog
nodes.description: Chronological record of all notable changes made to Voicebox, documenting new features, bug fixes, and platform improvements.
nodes.summary: Details v0.4.0 as the biggest release, adding HumeAI TADA, Kokoro 82M, and Qwen CustomVoice engines, plus GPU compatibility diagnostics and Intel Arc support.

nodes.name: Release Bump Skill Guide
nodes.description: Skill to finalize a release: stamps the [Unreleased] changelog, runs bumpversion, and creates a tagged release commit.
nodes.summary: Workflow involves verifying clean state, determining bump level, stamping changelog, and running bumpversion.
